title: Standing Down
summary: Brannoc has heard of the Third Legion, bound where it stood under the Sunken Chapel, that never deserted anything because nobody told it to stop. He'd like to stand with it once, the way he never stood with anyone.

steps.journal: Go down to the Binding Crypt, the Sunken Chapel's third floor, where the bound stand in rows, and hold five waves there with Brannoc.

objectives.label: Waves held in the Binding Crypt

ready: Tell Brannoc it's done: tap his party card, then Talk.
done: You held the Binding Crypt with Brannoc among the bound. He stood; they stood. He gave you his old chain, less one link.
